title: East Africa phone & Paybill normaliser input

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.description: Phone, Paybill or Till numbers as people type them, e.g. 0712 345 678, +256 772 123456, 255754123456, 247247. Up to 100,000 per run.

defaultCountry.title: Default country
defaultCountry.description: Used for numbers written without a country code.

kind.title: What the numbers are
kind.description: Paybill/Till are format-checked only (5-7 digits); there is no public registry to confirm them.
